description:
MMA-Diffusion Adversarial Images (Image modal attack)
	


The MMA-Diffusion adversarial images benchmark comprises 61 adversarial images generated by the adversarial attack methodology presented in the paper 
from CVPR 2024 titled MMA-Diffusion: MultiModal Attack on Diffusion Models. This resource is intended to assist in developing and 
evaluating defense mechanisms against such attacks. The adversarial images are designed to bypass the image safety checker in SDv1.5.

reputation: A specialized, recent CVPR-derived dataset for evaluating adversarial attacks on diffusion models with limited but growing interest among robustness/safety researchers.
